derivation.method: Authored from the pinned Steel Compendium only (canonical checkout at the main repo vendor/steel-compendium, HEAD fb83a789 verified with git rev-parse). Level-one baselines copied from tests/fixtures/v105-talent-expected.json (reviewed). No evaluator, content, convex or headless code read or run.
derivation.staminaMaximum: Talent Basics: Starting Stamina 18 + 6 per level after 1st; Density Augmentation +6 at levels 1-3 (increases by 6 at 4th, 7th, 10th). Battle Augmentation +3 only while wearing light armor (v105-5 baseline wears none). Levels 1-3 are echelon 1 (rule/general/echelon.md).
derivation.noNumericSheetChange: EXPLICIT: at levels 2 and 3 the only numeric sheet changes are Stamina maximum (+6 per level, class/talent.md Basics) and the recovery and winded values derived from it. No level-2 or level-3 Talent feature (Perk; Ease the Hours, Ease Their Fall, Ease the Mind; 2nd-Level Tradition Ability; Scan; 7-Clarity Ability), none of the ten abilities and none of the selected perks changes recoveries (8), speed, stability, disengage, characteristics, potency or size. Density Augmentation stays +6 Stamina and Battle Augmentation +3 (armor) until 4th level; Characteristic Increase first appears at 4th level. Situational values that are NOT sheet statistics: Ease Their Fall reduction 2 + R = 4 (Telekinesis witnesses); Applied Chronometrics +5 speed to targets and strained speed halving; Force Orbs cumulative damage immunity 1 per orb; Distance Augmentation extends Slow to Ranged 12 for v105-4.
derivation.abilityCounts: Advancement table: level 2 adds one 5-clarity tradition ability (Tradition Abilities 5); level 3 adds one 7-clarity ability (Abilities Two signature, 3, 5, 7).
derivation.traditionFeatures: 2nd-Level Tradition Feature grants ONE feature per tradition: Chronopathy - Ease the Hours; Telekinesis - Ease Their Fall; Telepathy - Ease the Mind.
derivation.abilityDamage: 'X + R' / 'X + P' add the Reason / Presence score (all witnesses R2, P2). Force Augmentation +1 to rolled damage of damage-dealing psionic abilities (v105-1 only). Density, Speed and Distance add no damage; Battle's +1 needs a light weapon and weapon ability (none of the ten has Weapon). No kit (Talent).
derivation.potency: Talent potency weak R-2 / average R-1 / strong R = 0/1/2 with Reason 2 (class/talent.md Basics; rule/character/potency.md).
derivation.clarityFloor: Unchanged: negative clarity limit 1 + R = 3 (feature/talent/level-1/clarity-and-strain.md); v105 resourceFloor -3.
derivation.perkChoice: One distinct eligible perk per witness, none with sub-choices, none granting an action, none already owned (all bases own only Teamwork, an exploration perk).

uncertainties.resolution: en/books/heroes/clean/Draw Steel Heroes.md lines 14231-14340: Chronopathy: Applied Chronometrics (14235), Slow (14253); Telekinesis: Gravitic Burst (14275), Levity and Gravity (14291); Telepathy: Overwhelm (14311), Synaptic Override (14327). Unified ability front matter 'subclass' agrees for all six.

uncertainties.passage: en/unified/md/feature/ability/talent/level-3/force-orbs.md: distance 'Self; see below'; orb fired 'at a creature or object within 5 squares as a ranged strike'; keywords Psionic, Ranged, Strike, Telekinesis.
uncertainties.resolution: Unresolved for v105-4 (Distance Augmentation, 'Your ranged psionic abilities gain a +2 bonus to distance'). Keep the orb range explicit/manual; ledger records printed 5 squares.
alternatives: orb strike range 7 (Distance Augmentation extends the 'within 5 squares' strike because the ability has Ranged and Psionic keywords)
orb strike range 5 (the ability's distance is 'Self', which has no numeric ranged distance to increase)

uncertainties.passage: Slow and Soul Burn Strained: 'The potency of this ability increases by 1'. rule/character/potency.md 'Adjusting Potencies' gives no formula for a flat potency increase.
uncertainties.resolution: Interpretation: each tier's potency value +1 (weak 0->1, average 1->2, strong 2->3 for every witness). Recorded as strainedPotencyByWitness; application is manual because Strained state is a table condition.
alternatives: only the potency of the tier achieved is raised (numerically identical per outcome)
raise by one potency step (weak->average) instead of by 1 point (numerically identical here since steps are 1 apart)

uncertainties.passage: en/unified/md/feature/talent/level-1/force-augmentation.md: 'Your damage-dealing psionic abilities gain a +1 bonus to rolled damage.'
uncertainties.resolution: Applies to Fling Through Time for v105-1 (Psionic keyword, deals rolled damage): [3,5,8] + P2 + 1 = [6,8,11]. Matches the v105 method ('Force adds 1 to rolled Psionic damage only'). No other Force witness chose a damaging level-2/3 ability.

uncertainties.passage: Gravitic Burst tiers '3 damage / 6 damage / 9 damage' and Force Orbs '2 / 3 / 5 damage' print no characteristic term.
uncertainties.resolution: Printed values used as-is; no characteristic is added (the roll characteristic modifies the power roll only). They are still rolled damage (rule/damage/rolled-damage.md) so Force Augmentation would add +1 had a Force witness chosen them.
alternatives: none; the text prints no '+ R'

uncertainties.passage: en/unified/md/feature/talent/level-1/battle-augmentation.md: '+3 bonus to Stamina' only 'While you wear light armor'; bonus increases at 4th, 7th, 10th.
uncertainties.resolution: v105-5 reviewed level-one Stamina is 18 (no armor worn). Ledger keeps no armor: 24 at L2, 30 at L3. With light armor worn it would be 27 / 33 (recovery 9 / 11, winded 13 / 16).
alternatives: light armor worn: +3 Stamina at levels 1-3

uncertainties.passage: en/unified/md/feature/ability/talent/level-3/soul-burn.md keywords include Animapathy, a tradition not offered by Talent Tradition in this build.
uncertainties.resolution: The 7-Clarity Ability feature lists Soul Burn among options for every talent; the keyword does not gate selection. No tradition-keyword interaction exists at levels 1-3 for these witnesses.

uncertainties.passage: en/unified/md/feature/talent/level-3/scan.md: line of effect persists within 'distance of your Mind Spike ability'.
uncertainties.resolution: Mind Spike is Psionic + Ranged 10, so for v105-4 (Distance Augmentation) the Scan distance is Ranged 12; others Ranged 10.
alternatives: Scan uses printed Mind Spike distance 10 regardless of augmentation

uncertainties.passage: Strained clauses of Slow, Synaptic Override (1d6), Fling Through Time, Reflector Field, Soul Burn (2d6), Levity and Gravity (half the target's damage).
uncertainties.resolution: Self-damage on strain is variable/manual; not part of damageByWitness.

automaticFeatures.name: Scan
automaticFeatures.summary: You can extend your psionic senses beyond their usual range. Once on each of your turns, you can search for hidden creatures as a free maneuver (see Hide and Sneak in Chapter 9: Tests). Additionally, once you establish line of effect to a thinking creature within distance of your Mind Spike ability, you always have line of effect to that creature until they move beyond that distance.

Mind Spike is Ranged 10 (Psionic, Ranged, Strike, Telepathy); for v105-4 (Distance Augmentation) that distance is Ranged 12, all others Ranged 10.
